standard_prerequisites.name: Construction of derived restriction
standard_prerequisites.use: By construction, RHom(N, M) is computed by choosing a quasi-isomorphism M -> I with I a differential graded B-module of property (I) and setting RHom(N, M) = Hom in Mod^dg_(B,d) from N to I.

standard_prerequisites.name: Hom-complex cohomology identification
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same unit, Example example-dgm-dg-cat and Lemma lemma-hom-derived
standard_prerequisites.use: The cohomology in each degree of the Hom-complex between differential graded modules is Hom in the homotopy category after shifting (standard dg-category fact recorded in the example); the property (P) case of the hypothesis is supplied by Lemma lemma-hom-derived.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 5381-5394): if Hom in D(B, d) from N to any N' equals Hom in K(Mod_(B,d)) (for example when N has property (P) as a differential graded B-module), then RHom(N, M) = Hom in Mod^dg_(B,d) from N to M, functorially in M in D(B, d).
Construction setup (proof lines 5395-5400): by Lemma lemma-derived-restriction choose a quasi-isomorphism M -> I with I of property (I); then RHom(N, M) = Hom^dg(N, I).

Quasi-isomorphism step (lines 5400-5407): by the hypothesis, the map Hom^dg(N, M) -> Hom^dg(N, I) induced by M -> I is a quasi-isomorphism - on cohomology in each degree it is the map Hom_K(N, M[n]) -> Hom_K(N, I[n]), which is an isomorphism because M -> I is an isomorphism in D(B, d) and the hypothesis identifies Hom_D with Hom_K (the degree-wise identification is the standard fact recorded in the in-source example).
Property (P) case (lines 5408-5410): if N has property (P) as a B-module, the hypothesis holds by Lemma lemma-hom-derived.
proof_roadmap: Insert the property (I) computation of RHom from the construction lemma.
Use the D = K hypothesis on N to get a quasi-isomorphism of Hom-complexes, degree by degree.
Verify the hypothesis for property (P) modules via the in-source lemma.
difficulty_reason: Computation lemma (statement 5381-5394, proof 5395-5410): RHom from N agrees with the underived dg-Hom once N is right-orthogonal in D = K - the proof combines the construction of RHom with the degree-wise homotopy-category identification; the mechanism (hypothesis in, quasi-isomorphism out) is stated in the span with the standard identification cited to the in-source example; no step is marked omitted. H2: reduction with a standard dg-category input.
